# Electronics For You

> > India's premier electronics engineering community offering DIY projects, expert insights, live training, and industry resources since 1969.

Electronics For You (EFY) is a comprehensive platform serving engineers, makers, and tech enthusiasts with hands-on DIY projects, professional training, job opportunities, and the longest-running electronics magazine in India. The site combines community-driven content with premium membership benefits through EFY PRIME.

## Key Topics

- DIY Electronics Projects
- Raspberry Pi
- AI & Machine Learning
- IoT & Smart Home
- Hardware Projects
- QR Code Technology
- Electronics Community
- EFY PRIME Membership
- Engineering Resources
- Electronics Magazine
- Live Training Sessions
- Job Portal
- Phantom Energy
- Circuit Design
- Robotics

## Core Resources

- [Electronics For You | DIY Projects, News, Jobs, and Expert Insights](https://www.electronicsforu.com): Homepage offering DIY projects, tutorials, news, jobs, and expert insights
- [Electronics For You Magazine](https://www.electronicsforu.com/magazine): India's first monthly electronics engineering publication since 1969
- [About Electronics For You](https://www.electronicsforu.com/about-us): Community of engineers, innovators, and tech enthusiasts shaping electronics

## DIY Projects & Learning

- [EXCITING DIY PROJECTS: Projects For Registered Users Only](https://www.electronicsforu.com/premium-diy-electronics-projects): Premium DIY electronics projects for registered EFY PRIME members
- [Submit Your Project - Electronics For You](https://www.electronicsforu.com/submit-your-project): Community project submission platform with 2-week review process
- [Live DIY Session In English And Hindi](https://www.electronicsforu.com/efy-diy-training): Live bilingual DIY training sessions for electronics projects
- [I Turned Raspberry Pi into a QR Code based Entry System](https://www.electronicsforu.com/electronics-projects/qr-entry-system-raspberry-pi-project): Raspberry Pi QR code entry system with auto ID card automation
